messages:
Maya (People Ops): Quick update: we rolled out two handbook edits today — 'Paid Time Off (PTO) accrual' and 'Mandatory Compliance Training cadence'. Please skim and confirm by next Friday. Link: https://redwood.internal/handbook/updates.

Ethan L.: Do the PTO accrual changes affect people who are on reduced hours or voluntary part-time?

Maya (People Ops): Good Q. The accrual formula now pro-rates based on FTE. We added an example table for common FTE values. Short-term reduced schedules (<30 days) will still use the original accrual for that pay period; long-term changes should be handled via a change-of-status form.

Sofia (Legal): For the training cadence piece, confirm we kept the exemption language for contractors who do not access customer data? Need that in writing for contracts.

Maya (People Ops): Yes — contractors with no access to customer data are exempt. Contractors with any access are included and will be assigned the module. We also added a checkbox for new SOW sign-offs in the vendor onboarding flow.

Devon (Recruiting): How should hiring managers communicate the new training requirement to candidates with offers?

Maya (People Ops): Include a note in the offer packet: "Redwood requires completion of Required Compliance Training within 30 days of start for roles with data access." Recruiting, remind offers this week.

Compliance Bot: automated: Compliance training assigned: "Handbook Essentials (2026)" to 98 staff, 34 contractors. Due date: 1726068800.

Ethan L.: What's the audit retention period for training completion records?

Sofia (Legal): Two years minimum. Add that to the handbook note and People Ops should export records quarterly to the compliance S3.

Maya (People Ops): Will do. Also adding a manager checklist item: verify team training statuses during performance calibration cycles.

Devon (Recruiting): For new hires starting next week, can we bulk-assign the training on their first day?

Maya (People Ops): Yes — Recruiting can trigger the bulk assignment flow. I posted the quick steps in the onboarding runbook (link in handbook update).

Ethan L.: Any change to performance review timelines?

Maya (People Ops): No change to the cycle dates. We just added a reminder to include training status as part of the performance packet.

Sofia (Legal): Also flag: managers must document approved extension requests for non-completion. We need a clear digital paper trail.

Maya (People Ops): Agreed. Use the HR ticket system for extension requests — that will be our audit trail.

Devon (Recruiting): Thanks. I'll update offer templates and let hiring teams know.

Maya (People Ops): Thanks all. I'll send a short announcement in #general after we sync with marketing."
